title: run(): load_messages() + initial load + chat selection reload
description:
What: Add async helper load_messages_for_chat(), call it on startup and whenever selected_chat changes.

Algorithm:
1. Add pub(crate) async fn load_messages_for_chat(http_client: &reqwest::Client, api_url: &str, chat_id: &str) -> Result<VecDeque<String>, kith_tui::client::ClientError>:
   a. Build JmapRequest call 1: ["Message/query", {"accountId":"a-self","filter":{"chatId":chat_id},"position":0,"limit":50}, "mq0"].
   b. Send via call_jmap. Parse ids: Vec<String> from response. If empty, return Ok(VecDeque::new()) without a second call.
   c. Build JmapRequest call 2: ["Message/get", {"accountId":"a-self","ids":ids}, "mg0"].
   d. Send via call_jmap. Parse list: Vec<serde_json::Value> from response.
   e. For each message Value: extract receivedAt:&str (take chars [11..16] = HH:MM), senderId:&str, body:&str.
   f. Sender display name: if senderId=="self" use "me"; else look up in a contacts parameter (passed as &HashMap<String,String>); fallback to senderId.
   g. Format: sanitize_display(&format!("{} {}: {}", hhmm, sender_name, body)).
   h. Collect into VecDeque, in receivedAt ascending order (oldest first = top of screen, newest at bottom).
   i. Return Ok(messages).
2. Update load_messages_for_chat signature to also accept contacts: &HashMap<String,String>.
3. In event::run(), after Chat/get completes: if state.chat_ids is non-empty, call load_messages_for_chat for state.chat_ids[state.selected_chat]; set state.messages = result; reset state.scroll_offset = 0.
4. Track prev_selected_chat: usize in the event loop. After each event is processed: if state.selected_chat != prev_selected_chat, reload messages and reset scroll. Update prev_selected_chat.

Defensive programming rules:
- receivedAt[11..16] slice: guard with .get(11..16).unwrap_or("??") — receivedAt is guaranteed RFC3339 by kithd but be safe.
- If load_messages_for_chat returns Err: set state.messages = VecDeque::new() and log error; do not panic.
- Cap messages at 50 (already enforced by limit=50 in query).
- sanitize_display() on body and sender_name before formatting.

Agent team: R reads event.rs, app.rs, client.rs; I implements; T writes wiremock tests; V runs cargo test + clippy.

Tests (oracle: known mock data):
- wiremock: mock Message/query returning ["m1","m2"], Message/get returning [{id:"m1",senderId:"self",body:"Hi",receivedAt:"2026-04-19T13:45:00Z",...},{id:"m2",senderId:"c-1",body:"Hey",receivedAt:"2026-04-19T13:46:00Z",...}] -> state.messages=["13:45 me: Hi","13:46 Alice: Hey"].
- wiremock: mock Message/query returning [] -> state.messages is empty, no Message/get call.
- Unit: senderId=="self" -> displays as "me" (oracle: code spec).
- Unit: receivedAt="2026-04-19T08:05:00Z" -> HH:MM is "08:05" (oracle: string slice [11..16]).
